newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Education Management starts as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Education Management starts as buy.

text.p: --Barrington Research Associates Inc said on Tuesday it initiated coverage of Education Management Corp with a 1-Buy, its strongest buy rating.
--Its EPS estimates on the company are $0.65 for 1997 and $0.80 for 1998.

--Pittsburgh-based Education Management provides proprietary postsecondary education in the United States. It completed an initial public offering of 5.1 million shares at $15 per share on October 31.
--Education Management's stock was unchanged at 20-1/2 in midafternoon exchange trading.
